family: R3-N3 neutral: TP1 take-fraction exit matrix on frozen v30 isotonic-4 x {1x, dd_guard}
hypothesis: Varying the frozen TP1 take fraction (share of notional closed at TP1, remainder to TP2/timeout; known at signal time as a frozen per-branch constant, causal past-only) may shift the monthly-geometric/DD frontier. Engine default 0.5 everywhere and untried; this narrow exit-micro-structure matrix is the honest novelty. Exploratory only.
tp1_note: tp1_fraction is a frozen ExecutionConfig constant per branch (0<f<1, asserted). Frozen signals carry a tp1_fraction=0.5 column that the engine ignores (engine reads ExecutionConfig only); the probe overwrites that column per branch for artifact provenance with no engine effect. No per-signal fitting; same 94 frozen signals in every branch.
control: tp050_1x (tp1=0.5/1x) must match published isotonic_4 exposure1.0 normal (+122.80% total_return, -20.09% max_drawdown, 65 trades) or STOP
dd_guard_reference: tp050_1x (tp1=0.5) control sampled equity (trade exit_time/equity_after), past-only 1-microsecond cutoff, 100.0 seed level; each dd_guard branch applies the guard state at its OWN signal times. Shared single reference keeps tp fractions comparable. Disclosed deviation from v03 (own-book per branch).
